battle.name: 堪薩斯內戰
battle.theater: 堪薩斯領地與密蘇里邊境
battle.brief: 一八五四年五月三十日，密蘇里門戶開放令撕毀密蘇里妥協案，堪薩斯領地成為自由州派與蓄奴州派競逐之地。五月二十一日，密蘇里「邊境黨」武裝劫掠自由州重鎮勞倫斯；六月六日，約翰·布朗率七人迎戰數百名密蘇里人，於奧薩瓦托米幾近全滅。雷管步槍在此成為散兵與狙擊手的長槍。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是自由州派與蓄奴州派，兩者都沒有正規軍，衝突從一八五四年延續到一八五九年，餘波一直拖到堪薩斯建州。自由州派以新英格蘭與紐約的廢奴團體為後盾：一八五四年成立於麻州波士頓的新英格蘭移民援助公司，連同紐約中央委員會等組織，募款、募兵、運槍，組織東北部移民在堪薩斯落戶，由這些移民中熟悉槍械的老兵組成所謂「武裝公司」；自由州派的指揮系統相當鬆散，靠各公司的帶隊人與地方民團運作，一八五四年十月在托皮卡召開的自由州議會與親蓄奴派爭同一批席位，隨後自行組織議會並推舉查爾斯·約翰·布朗為「州長」，一八五五年底詹姆斯·希恩·萊恩以「堪薩斯軍團」把散兵整合成能夠行軍的縱隊。蓄奴州派以密蘇里州的奴隸制支持者為骨幹，被對方稱為「邊境黨」，多以密蘇里鄉鎮為基地越境作戰，後來得到領地總督威爾遜·香農、羅伯特·沃克與一八五七年到任的詹姆斯·丹佛的支持，也得到聯邦政府的默許。聯邦方面，總統皮爾斯站在蓄奴派一邊，陸軍部長傑斐遜·戴維斯把萊文沃思堡與拉利堡的步兵派往堪薩斯，並把聯邦軍械庫中被扣押的步槍配給親蓄奴的民兵。中部平原的數個部族（堪薩、卡奧、奧馬哈等）則在美利堅合眾國與堪薩斯領地之間劃出「中立區」，禁止白人移入，一八五四年十月與聯邦簽訂中立區條約，一八五五年由喬治·西布萊實地勘界。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Free-Staters and the pro-slavery party, and neither had a regular army; the fighting ran from 1854 into 1859, and its after-effects lasted until Kansas was admitted as a state. The Free-Staters were backed by abolitionist organisations in New England and New York: the New England Emigrant Aid Company, founded at Boston, Massachusetts, in 1854, together with bodies such as the New York Central Committee, raised money, raised men and shipped arms, settling New England immigrants in Kansas, where the old hands among those immigrants formed what were called armed companies. Their command structure was loose, resting on company leaders and local militia; the Free-State legislature that met at Topeka in October 1854 disputed the very same seats with the pro-slavery faction, then organised itself and elected Charles John Brown as its governor, and at the end of 1855 James H. Lane organised the Army of the Kansas, turning scattered bands into a column that could march. The pro-slavery party had the slaveholding settlers of Missouri as its backbone; the other side called them the Border Ruffians. They worked out of Missouri towns, crossed the border to fight and were supported later by the territorial governors Wilson Shannon, Robert Walker and James W. Denver, and tacitly by the federal government. On the federal side President Pierce stood with the pro-slavery party, and the Secretary of War Jefferson Davis sent infantry from Fort Leavenworth and Fort Riley into Kansas and issued arms held in federal depots to pro-slavery militia. Among the peoples of the central plains, the Kansa, Kaw and Omaha and their neighbours marked out a neutral ground between the United States and the Territory of Kansas, barring white settlement there; they concluded a neutrality treaty with the federal government in October 1854, and the line was surveyed on the ground in 1855 by George Sibley.
people: 關鍵人物可以分成三批。第一批是約翰·布朗：生於一八〇〇年麻州康科德，長老會牧師，原在紐約北厄爾巴一帶牧羊（該地一八五五年劃入佛蒙特州），一八五四年五月帶長子約翰與次子弗雷德里克西行入堪薩斯。他的人數雖少，卻把衝突的性質從選舉鬥爭變成街頭暴力：六月六日奧薩瓦托米之戰，他與四個兒子及數名同伴共七、八人，對上密蘇里方面數百人，頭部中彈、左臂被砍傷，仍由同伴掩護撤回；事後他們連夜燒了阿奇森在奧薩瓦托米的住宅。一八五五年末至一八五六年初，他策劃波塔瓦托米行動，五月二十四至二十五日夜在富蘭克林縣殺死五名蓄奴州定居者，作為勞倫斯之劫的報復，事後被通緝，遭郡府武力驅逐。一八五八年十二月他重返堪薩斯，一八五九年十月十六至十七日率十餘人夜襲西維吉尼亞哈珀斯費里的聯邦軍火庫，奪得步槍並自製長矛；十月十八日被羅伯特·李上校率領的海軍陸戰隊與騎兵在鎮外逮捕，十二月初在維吉尼亞州夏洛茨維爾受絞刑，兩個兒子也同時赴死。第二批是密蘇里一方的政治人物：聯邦參議員大衛·賴斯·阿奇森自稱在奧薩瓦托米指揮了攻擊，郡治安德魯·約翰遜在勞倫斯之劫中站在最前線，兩人後來都因在各自的選區被選民否決而政治失勢；領地總督威爾遜·香農曾向聯邦求援，羅伯特·沃克與詹姆斯·丹佛依序接任。第四批是自由州派：詹姆斯·希恩·萊恩被稱為「陰沉的首領」，一八五五年底組織「堪薩斯軍團」，一八五六年一月率隊進軍托皮卡；查爾斯·約翰·布朗以「州長」身分主持托皮卡制憲；牧師艾薩克·古德諾是《堪薩斯先驅報》主編；牧師弗朗西斯·斯萊克是援助公司的武裝總監；哈羅德·格里利則在《紐約論壇報》上推廣「流血的堪薩斯」一語。
peopleEn: The key figures fall into three groups. The first is John Brown, born in 1800 at Concord, Massachusetts, a Presbyterian minister who had been shearing sheep at North Elba in New York, a place transferred to Vermont in 1855. In May 1854 he travelled west to Kansas with his eldest son John and his second son Frederick. His band was small, yet it changed the character of the conflict from an electoral contest into street violence: at the battle of Osawatomie on 6 June he and four of his sons with a few companions, seven or eight men in all, faced several hundred Missourians, was shot in the head and had his left arm cut away, and was still carried back by his companions; afterwards they burned Atchison's house at Osawatomie that same night. Between the end of 1855 and the beginning of 1856 he organised the Pottawatomie action, and on the night of 24 to 25 May killed five pro-slavery settlers in Franklin County in reprisal for the sack of Lawrence; he was afterwards wanted by the authorities and driven out by county militia. He returned to Kansas in December 1858 and on the night of 16 to 17 October 1859 led a dozen men into the federal arsenal at Harpers Ferry, West Virginia, taking rifles and forging pikes; on the eighteenth he was taken outside the town by marines and cavalry under Colonel Robert E. Lee, and in early December he was hanged at Charlottesville, Virginia, two of his sons dying with him. The second group is the Missouri politicians: the federal senator David Rice Atchison claimed he had commanded the attack at Osawatomie, and Sheriff Andrew Johnson stood at the head of the raid on Lawrence; both were later voted out in their own districts and suffered political eclipse; the territorial governor Wilson Shannon called on the federal government for troops, and Robert Walker and James W. Denver succeeded him in turn. The fourth group belongs to the Free-Staters: James H. Lane, called the Grim Chieftain, organised the Army of the Kansas at the end of 1855 and marched on Topeka in January 1856; Charles John Brown presided over the Topeka constitutional convention as governor; the Reverend Isaac Goodnow edited the Kansas Herald; the Reverend Francis H. Slack was adjutant of the Emigrant Aid Company's military operations; and Horace Greeley popularised the phrase Bleeding Kansas in the New-York Tribune.
kits: 卡面這支雷管步槍屬於一八四〇年前後的歐洲火器譜系：雷管點火由法國人德爾維涅在一八二九年提出，用可擊發的銅雷管取代火燧的燧石與火鍋，法國隨後在一八四〇年制式步槍上全面換用雷管，槍機變得可在潮濕、霧天可靠擊發，擊發時間由數秒縮到一瞬。就堪薩斯的體系而言，這一族長槍的實際型號多來自美國：夏普斯步槍（一八五〇年型）以跌落式槍機配雷管，精度與射程都勝過舊式滑膛槍，由新英格蘭移民援助公司運入，成為自由州派狙擊手的標誌武器；柯爾特一八五五年轉輪步槍與轉輪手槍同樣是雷管身家，密蘇里邊境黨人特別倚重柯爾特一八三〇年代轉輪手槍與短管霰彈槍，配合獵槍與刀，構成騎馬散兵的標準配裝。除長槍之外，雙方都沒有制式服裝與制式背包，裝備來源雜亂：密蘇里方面靠跨州購置與搶奪物資，自由州方面靠援助公司與慈善捐款自波士頓、紐約、費城沿河運來，經密蘇里河與堪薩斯河轉運，再以馬車隊分送各鎮。全場唯一的一門火炮，是一八五四年五月由萊文沃思堡方面送來的小口徑野砲，在勞倫斯之劫中用來轟擊房屋，隨後被自由州人奪下拋入河中。運輸同樣靠馬與船：聖菲小徑經拉利堡通往西部，落磯山以東的堪薩斯沒有鐵路通達邊境以外，郵件與軍火多由蒸汽船與馬車接力。攻城器械完全沒有，這是一場以步槍、轉輪槍與馬匹為主的邊境衝突。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on this card belongs to the European arms lineage of around 1840: percussion priming was proposed by the Frenchman Delvigne in 1829, replacing the flint and the pan of the matchlock with a strikeable copper cap, and France then adopted the percussion system on its regulation musket of 1840, so that the lock could be fired reliably in damp weather and fog and the time between orders and shots fell from several seconds to an instant. As far as Kansas is concerned, the actual patterns of this family of long arms came mostly from America: the Sharps rifle of the 1850 pattern used a falling-block action with a percussion cap and was more accurate and longer-ranged than the old smoothbore muskets; it was shipped in by the New England Emigrant Aid Company and became the signature weapon of the Free-State sharpshooters. The Colt revolving rifle and revolver of 1855 belonged to the same percussion family, and the Missouri Border Ruffians relied in particular on Colt revolvers of the 1830s together with short-barrelled shotguns, backed by hunting rifles and knives, which made up the standard kit of mounted skirmishers. Beyond their long arms neither side had uniform clothing or uniform packs, and equipment supply was haphazard: the Missouri side bought across state lines and took what it could seize, while the Free-Staters relied on the Emigrant Aid Company and on charitable subscriptions sent by river from Boston, New York and Philadelphia, transhipped along the Missouri and Kansas rivers and then distributed to the towns by wagon trains. The single artillery piece in the whole war was a small field gun sent out from Fort Leavenworth in May 1854 and used to fire on the houses during the sack of Lawrence; the Free-Staters afterwards captured it and threw it into the river. Transport likewise depended on horses and boats: the Santa Fe Trail ran through Fort Riley towards the west, and Kansas east of the Rockies had no railway reaching beyond its borders, so mail and ordnance travelled by steamer and wagon in relays. There were no siege engines at all; this was a frontier conflict fought with rifles, revolvers and horses.
tactics: 這場衝突從來沒有打成形式會戰，雙方都不具備線列步兵的編制，因此戰法是一套以散兵、狙擊與襲擊為主的邊境打法。勞倫斯之劫是白日進城：密蘇里武裝約八十至一百人，先以野砲向街道與房屋射擊，再逐屋搜索，搶走印刷機與砲，縱火後即行退去。奧薩瓦托米之戰則是典型的近身混戰：布朗一方人數太少，密蘇里人密集湧上，步槍射程在百步之內完全失效，最終靠馬匹與地形脫身。自由州派在防守戰中用上了遠射步槍的價值——夏普斯步槍的狙擊手埋伏在樹籬、果樹林與農舍之間，等密蘇里人列隊行進、密度堆高時才開火，用數百碼外的精確射擊消耗人數，再以轉輪手槍與霰彈槍在近身距離上爭奪。密蘇里方則以人數與騎兵迂迴取勝，常趁日落前後襲擊孤立的據點，並在一八五五年策動「鐵路戰爭」，拆毀密蘇里太平洋鐵路堪薩斯城與韋斯特波特支線的路軌，企圖阻止鐵路鋪進堪薩斯，切斷自由州派最重的補給來源。兩條補給線的形態也不同：密蘇里人從密蘇里州的村鎮出發，過境作戰再騎馬返回；自由州派的槍械糧食沿密蘇里河與堪薩斯河由蒸汽船運來，再轉馬車。一八五四年十一月至十二月的瓦卡魯薩戰爭是唯一一次大規模集結：自由州民兵一兩千人向拉利堡與拉恩德堡進逼，卻沒有交戰，總督乘夜逃逸，十二月中旬議和；一八五六年一月萊恩的「進軍托皮卡」同樣是一次以行軍代替戰鬥的行動，用縱隊的陣容迫使對方承認議會。槍械技術的改變正是這些打法的前提：雷管讓遠射精準可靠，步槍的有效射程拉長，線列齊射不再是唯一可行的開火方式，縱隊與密集隊形在邊境林地與村落裡很容易被拆散，於是整場戰爭看不到會戰，只見狙擊、追擊與縱火。
tacticsEn: This conflict was never fought as a set-piece battle. Neither side possessed the organisation for a linear infantry army, so the method was a frontier style of skirmishing, sharpshooting and raid. The sack of Lawrence was a day assault on a town: eighty to a hundred Missourians came in, opened fire on the streets and the houses with a field gun, searched the houses one by one, took the printing press and the cannon, set fires and then rode home. The battle of Osawatomie was the opposite, a close-in melee in which the Missourians closed in so densely on Brown's handful that the reach of the rifles was worthless inside a hundred paces, and only horses and broken ground carried him away. The Free-Staters made the value of the long-range rifle felt on the defensive: sharpshooters with Sharps rifles lay in hedgerows, orchards and farmsteads and opened fire only when the Missourians were marching in column and their files had closed up, thinning them with accurate shooting at several hundred yards and then fighting for the last hundred yards with revolvers and shotguns. The Missouri side won by numbers and by riding round the flank, striking isolated posts around sunset, and in 1855 it mounted the railroad war, tearing up the track of the Kansas City and Westport branches of the Missouri Pacific in the hope of keeping the rails out of Kansas and cutting the heaviest source of Free-State supply. The two lines of supply were shaped differently as well: the Missourimen started from the towns of Missouri, fought across the line and rode home again; the Free-Staters had their arms and provisions carried up the Missouri and Kansas rivers by steamer and then transferred to wagons. The Wakarusa campaign of November and December 1854 was the one mass assembly: a thousand or two thousand Free-State militia advanced on Fort Riley and Fort Larned without a shot being fired, the governor fled by night, and there was an accommodation in mid-December; Lane's march on Topeka in January 1856 was likewise a manoeuvre in place of a battle, the marching column compelling the other side to recognise the legislature. The change in the arms is the premise of all this: percussion made distant shooting accurate and reliable, the effective range of the rifle grew, the volley in line was no longer the only possible way to fire, and columns and close formations came apart easily in the frontier woods and farmsteads. Hence no battle in this war, only sharpshooting, pursuit and arson.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。《堪薩斯－內布拉斯加法》於一八五四年五月三十日由總統皮爾斯簽署，撕毀一八二〇年密蘇里妥協案對密蘇里西部奴隸制的限制。領地人口在兩年內由數百增至上萬，兩種制度的支持者在境內並行。一八五四年五月二十一日勞倫斯之劫，投入的密蘇里武裝約八十至一百人，帶一門野砲；同年六月二日黑傑克之戰在堪薩斯最南端爆發，是自由州派與蓄奴州派的首次武裝衝突，以自由州派小勝告終；六月六日奧薩瓦托米之戰，布朗一方七至八人，密蘇里一方說法在三百至五百人之間，自由州一方陣亡五人，布朗本人頭部中彈並被砍傷。一八五四年十一月底至十二月中旬的瓦卡魯薩戰爭，自由州民兵集結一兩千人而未打一仗。一八五五年十月領地議會選舉，自由州派得票約為蓄奴州派的兩倍；同年年底援助公司運入的槍械已足以武裝數百人。一八五五年爆發的「鐵路戰爭」中，密蘇里武裝拆毀密蘇里太平洋鐵路兩條支線的路軌。一八五六年一月初萊恩率大隊進軍托皮卡，人數在一千五百上下。五月二十四至二十五日夜波塔瓦托米事件造成五名蓄奴州定居者死亡。一八五六年五月約翰·蓋里到任接管軍政；同年十二月公投中，托皮卡憲法在自由州縣被人為灌入上萬張偽造選票。一八五九年十月十六至十七日哈珀斯費里軍火庫被襲，十八日布朗被捕，十二月初處刑。整場「流血的堪薩斯」的死亡人數各方統計不一，通常認為不足百人，這在十九世紀的北美衝突中屬極小規模。堪薩斯於一八六一年一月二十九日加入聯邦，成為第三十四州。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The Kansas-Nebraska Act was signed by President Pierce on 30 May 1854, overriding the restriction on slavery west of Missouri imposed by the Missouri Compromise of 1820. The population of the territory grew from several hundreds to more than ten thousand within two years, with adherents of both systems living side by side. In the sack of Lawrence on 21 May 1854 some eighty to a hundred Missourians took part, bringing a field gun with them; on 2 June of the same year the fight at Black Jack broke out at the southernmost edge of Kansas, the first armed clash between Free-Staters and pro-slavery settlers, and ended in a Free-State victory; at Osawatomie on 6 June Brown had seven or eight men against a Missouri force variously put at three to five hundred, the Free-Staters lost five men, and Brown himself was shot in the head and cut. In the Wakarusa campaign from late November to mid-December 1854 a thousand or two thousand Free-State militia assembled without a shot being fired. In the October 1855 territorial legislative election the Free-Staters polled roughly twice the vote of the pro-slavery party, and by the end of that year the arms shipped in by the Emigrant Aid Company sufficed to equip several hundred men. In the railroad war of 1855 the Missourians tore up the track on two branches of the Missouri Pacific. In early January 1856 Lane marched on Topeka with a column of about fifteen hundred men. On the night of 24 to 25 May the Pottawatomie action killed five pro-slavery settlers. In May 1856 John Geary arrived to take charge of the government and the military, and in the referendum of December that year the Topeka constitution was carried in the Free-State counties by up to some ten thousand fraudulent ballots cast into them. The arsenal at Harpers Ferry was raided on the night of 16 to 17 October 1859, Brown was arrested on the eighteenth, and he was executed in early December. The death toll of the whole of Bleeding Kansas differs between the accounts and is generally put at fewer than one hundred men, an extremely small scale for a North American conflict of the nineteenth century. Kansas was admitted to the Union on 29 January 1861 as the thirty-fourth state.
cause: 打起來的原因是奴隸制邊界線上的一次制度對撞，而引信是一八五四年通過的一部土地法。前因要退回一八二〇年的密蘇里妥協案：該案禁止密蘇里州西部引入奴隸制，使當時屬路易斯安那購地的堪薩斯保持自由州地位。一八五〇年妥協案加上《逃亡奴隸法》之後，北方廢奴派與南方蓄奴派的衝突升級，爭點從「領土能否容納奴隸制」變成「誰決定領土的制度」。一八五四年，民主黨參議員史蒂芬·道格拉斯提出《堪薩斯－內布拉斯加法》，以「人民主權」取代密蘇里妥協案：兩個新領地允許居民投票決定奴隸制，並且廢除密蘇里州與內布拉斯加對奴隸制的限制。道格拉斯在南方因此被稱為「偉大的討價還價者」，這部法律在兩院分別得到民主黨與南方議員支持；北方廢奴者視之為背叛，組織援助公司，把武裝移民直接送進堪薩斯；南方則組織蓄奴州移民湧入同一片土地。直接導火線是土地與選票：堪薩斯對移民免徵土地出讓金、免除兵役，是奴隸制邊界上唯一可以靠遷徙決定歸屬的地方，兩邊的人幾乎同時湧到。一八五四年五月二十一日的勞倫斯之劫是第一聲槍，六月六日奧薩瓦托米之戰則把衝突推到有組織武裝對抗的層面，此後的瓦卡魯薩戰爭、鐵路戰爭與波塔瓦托米事件都是這條因果鏈上的下一環。
causeEn: The war came out of a collision of systems on the boundary of slavery, and the fuse was a land statute passed in 1854. The remote cause runs back to the Missouri Compromise of 1820, which forbade the introduction of slavery west of Missouri and so left Kansas, then part of the Louisiana Purchase, a free state. After the Compromise of 1850 and the Fugitive Slave Act the quarrel between northern abolitionists and southern slaveholders rose in temperature, and the question shifted from whether a territory might harbour slavery to who should decide the system a territory would have. In 1854 the Democratic senator Stephen Douglas introduced the Kansas-Nebraska Act, substituting popular sovereignty for the Missouri Compromise: the two new territories would decide for themselves by ballot whether to permit slavery, and the restrictions on slavery in Missouri and Nebraska were wiped out. Douglas earned the name of the Great Compromiser in the South for it, and the bill was carried in both houses by Democrats and southern members; northern abolitionists read it as a betrayal, organised the Emigrant Aid Company and sent armed settlers straight into Kansas, while the South organised slave-state migration into the same country. The proximate spark was land and votes: Kansas charged settlers no purchase money and no poll tax and exempted them from military service, and it was the one place on the boundary of slavery where the question of allegiance could be settled simply by moving there. Both sides arrived almost at once. The sack of Lawrence on 21 May 1854 was the first shot, the battle of Osawatomie on 6 June lifted the conflict to the level of organised armed opposition, and the Wakarusa campaign, the railroad war and the Pottawatomie action were the next links in the same chain.
impact: 這場邊境戰爭在全國層面造成的震動，遠超過它本身的傷亡數字。它給了奴隸制邊界問題一個具體而殘酷的形象，「流血的堪薩斯」成為一八五六年布坎南與道格拉斯競選時最主要的競選口號，南北兩邊都拿它說明對方的暴力。制度層面上，這場戰爭證實了一件事：只要聯邦政府站在爭議的一邊，廢奴者沒有任何自保手段，於是「聯邦必須干預」在北方成為愈來愈普遍的主張，而一八五六年布坎南在密蘇里州被支持為「撕裂國家」的候選人，正是這條邏輯的頂點。接下來的事是把這個邊界問題與選舉綁在一起：一八五七年的公投中，親蓄奴派用偽造選票與武力威脅維持對立法規，結果國會否決了萊科姆頓憲法，聯邦對堪薩斯的干預成為一八六〇年總統選舉最核心的爭點。布朗的哈珀斯費里襲擊則是另一層影響：他於一八五九年十月在弗吉尼亞被捕、十二月初被絞刑，這件事在北方被視為殉道，南方則視為暗殺，兩種敘事都把內戰的爆發時間表往前推；一八六〇年十月，他的兒子奧利弗·布朗與同人依他生前指示在哈珀斯費里執行報復性襲擊，把國家推向臨界點。另一個長遠後果是人口的重新分配：哈珀斯費里的消息引來大批援助志願者湧入堪薩斯，加上同年爆發的皮克峰淘金熱，堪薩斯人口迅速膨脹；內戰爆發後，許多「流血的堪薩斯」的老兵在聯邦與聯軍兩邊都出現過，卡在奴隸制邊界上的人最清楚兩邊的代價。
impactEn: The shock this frontier war produced across the country was far larger than its own casualty figures. It gave the question on the boundary of slavery a concrete and brutal image, and Bleeding Kansas became the central campaign slogan of the election of 1856 between Buchanan and Douglas, with each side citing it as proof of the other's violence. At the level of institutions the war demonstrated a single fact: as long as the federal government stood on one side of the dispute, abolitionists had no means of protecting themselves, and the argument that the federal government must intervene grew steadily more popular in the North; Buchanan's support in Missouri in 1856 as the candidate who would split the Union was the summit of that logic. What followed tied the boundary question to the ballot: in the referendums of 1857 the pro-slavery faction used fraudulent voting and armed intimidation to hold a legislature it had manufactured, the Lecompton constitution was rejected by Congress, and federal interference in Kansas became the central issue of the presidential election of 1860. Brown's raid on Harpers Ferry had an effect of a different kind: his arrest in Virginia in October 1859 and his hanging in early December were read in the North as martyrdom and in the South as assassination, and each narrative pushed the timetable of the coming civil war forward; in October 1860 his son Oliver Brown and others carried out retaliatory attacks at Harpers Ferry on his instructions, pushing the country to the brink. A further long-term consequence was the redistribution of population: the news from Harpers Ferry drew a flood of aid volunteers into Kansas, and the Pike's Peak gold rush of the same year swelled it further; when the civil war broke out, veterans of Bleeding Kansas could be found in both armies, and those who had stood on the boundary of slavery knew the cost on both sides.
result: 打完了，兩邊都沒有得到決定性的軍事勝利。整場衝突以游擊、縱火、暗殺與選舉鬥爭的形式進行，傷亡總數不足百人，沒有一次會戰，也沒有一方被徹底消滅；結束的標誌不是條約，而是兩份憲法與幾次選舉。自由州派在人口上贏了：堪薩斯在一八五七年十二月以托皮卡憲法當選州憲法，一八六一年一月二十九日獲准以自由州加入聯邦，成為第三十四州，此後內戰中大量堪薩斯營伍南送，南方軍隊中相當比例的士兵來自堪薩斯與密蘇里邊境。蓄奴派在制度上輸了：萊科姆頓憲法被選民否決、被國會駁回，領地總督與聯邦政府的堪薩斯政策被視為一連串失敗，民主黨在一八六〇年的分裂中崩解。個人層面上，約翰·布朗在哈珀斯費里被俘後於一八五九年十二月初受絞刑，兩個兒子同時殉難，他成了廢奴運動的烈士，也同時成了南方眼中北方「陰暗勢力」的具體形象；此後兩年內依他生前指示的報復行動持續發生，最終把國家的分裂推向內戰。從兵器史的角度看，這場戰爭是把雷管槍、轉輪槍與遠射步槍的邊境用法示範得最清楚的一次：精度射擊取代線列齊射，散兵與小隊游擊取代會戰，馬匹與騎射仍是機動主力。真正解決堪薩斯問題的，不是任何一方的武力，而是四年後的一場全國性內戰。
resultEn: When it was over, neither side had won a decisive military victory. The whole conflict was fought in the form of skirmishing, arson, assassination and electoral contest; the casualties numbered fewer than a hundred men, there was no battle and neither party was destroyed. It did not end with a treaty but with two constitutions and a series of elections. The Free-Staters won on numbers: having carried the Topeka constitution as their state constitution in December 1857, Kansas was admitted to the Union as a free state on 29 January 1861, the thirty-fourth state, and in the civil war that followed a great many Kansas regiments went south, with a substantial share of the southern army drawn from Kansas and the Missouri border. The pro-slavery party lost on institutions: the Lecompton constitution was rejected by the voters and thrown out by Congress, the territorial governors and the federal government's Kansas policy were written off as a string of failures, and the Democratic party broke apart in the split of 1860. At the level of individuals, John Brown, taken at Harpers Ferry, was hanged in the first days of December 1859 and two of his sons died with him; he became the martyr of the abolitionist movement and at the same time the very embodiment of the dark Northern element in Southern eyes, and the retaliatory actions ordered by him in his last instructions continued for the next two years, finally driving the division of the country into civil war. In the history of arms this war gave the clearest demonstration yet of the frontier use of percussion rifles, revolvers and long-range rifles: aimed fire replaced the volley, scattered skirmishers and small bands replaced set-piece battle, while the horse and mounted shooting remained the main means of movement. What settled the Kansas question in the end was not the force of either side but a nationwide civil war four years later.
